title: Fyodor Dostoevsky’s quote on pain & suffering: Timeless lesson on resilience
description: Fyodor Dostoevsky, a literary giant, delved into the human psyche, exploring guilt, faith, and redemption. His profound insights, shaped by personal suffering including a near-death execution and Siberian imprisonment, influenced psychology and philosophy. Dostoevsky's novels, like 'Crime and Punishment' and 'The Karamazov Brothers,' reveal that deep intelligence and compassion often come with unavoidable sadness, a truth that continues to resonate today.

title: Tom Cruise’s quote on ambition: Why success comes from action, not expectation
description: Hollywood icon Tom Cruise, known for his daring stunts and the 'Mission: Impossible' franchise, embodies his own powerful philosophy: 'In this life, it's not what you hope for, it's not what you deserve, it's what you take!' This mantra, from his role in 'Magnolia,' highlights the importance of proactive action and seizing opportunities to achieve dreams, a principle Cruise himself has lived by since his early days pursuing acting.

title: After Meta layoffs, Zuckerberg says firms should empower workers, not replace them
description: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg believes AI-driven job losses are exaggerated, advocating for tools that boost individual productivity. This comes as the tech giant laid off 8,000 employees, reassigning another 7,000 to AI projects, to offset significant investments in its AI "reboot." While Meta pours billions into AI infrastructure, Zuckerberg suggests a focus on human empowerment could create more jobs, a view contrasting with some industry leaders.

title: Microsoft plans another round of layoffs, may cut thousands of jobs across teams
description: Microsoft is gearing up for another round of job cuts, reportedly impacting sales, consulting, and Xbox divisions. While smaller than previous reductions, thousands of positions may be affected. This move comes as the tech giant prioritizes AI investments and cost control, even as its stock has seen a dip.  A voluntary retirement program earlier this year also aimed to manage headcount.

title: Sergey Brin sold his NYC real estate: Here's what Mamdani's rent freeze cost him
description: Google co-founder Sergey Brin has divested his stake in a New York City real estate fund for a fraction of its value, selling for just six cents on the dollar. This significant loss comes as Mayor Zohran Mamdani's rent freeze tightens conditions for landlords. The fund, A&E Real Estate, confirmed the sale, citing the challenging market for rent-stabilized apartments.
